values.meaning: heal scales with missing health, from 0% to 100% missing health at 11% per 0.6% missing health step (min at full HP, max at 60% missing HP)
values.quote: {{pp|type=his '''missing''' health|key=%|0 to 100 for 11|key1=%|0 to 60|formula=1% per 0.6% of '''Sylas'' missing health}}

mechanics.claim: Sylas dashes to the front of the target enemy's location then strikes them.
mechanics.quote: '''Sylas''' {{tip|dashes}} to the front of the target enemy's location then strikes them to deal {{as|magic damage}}.

mechanics.claim: The damage is dealt if the dash completes uninterrupted, regardless of the target's final position.
mechanics.quote: The damage will be dealt if the dash completed uninterrupted, and regardless of how far the target's location is at the end of the dash.

mechanics.claim: Sylas heals only if the strike damages a champion target, based on his own missing health.
mechanics.quote: If this damages a {{tip|champion}}, '''Sylas''' is also {{tip|heal|healed}}, increased by {{as|{{pp|type=his '''missing''' health

mechanics.claim: Sylas heals even if the target champion dies before the dash is completed, unless the target becomes untargetable, which negates the whole effect.
mechanics.quote: '''Sylas''' will heal even if the target champion dies before the dash is completed.

mechanics.claim: If the target becomes untargetable, Kingslayer has no effect.
mechanics.quote: The only exception is if the target becomes {{tip|untargetable}}, in which case ''Kingslayer'' will have no effect.

mechanics.claim: Casting Kingslayer generates an extra Hail of Blades stack despite not resetting the basic attack timer.
mechanics.quote: ''Kingslayer's'' cast generates an additional stack of {{ri|Hail of Blades}} despite the ability not {{tip|basic attack reset|resetting}} his basic attack timer.
